nodes.label: Gold Block Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture of a solid gold block. Bright yellow/golden color with subtle cross-hatch shading pattern to give a metallic shine effect. Used as a high-value decorative or crafting material block signifying wealth or rare loot.
nodes.pattern: uniform golden surface with subtle cross-hatch shading for metallic sheen
nodes.game_purpose: high-value metal block, decorative material, rare loot or boss room indicator
